title: Critical PHP RCE CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619: PHP2Shell enables unauthenticated remote code execution
content_md:
Critical PHP RCE CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619: PHP2Shell enables unauthenticated remote code execution. The attacker can run code through the web server without logging in.
